parsed.post: agent-4: MATRIX_LR 0.1 hurt: 1.104 -> 1.126, reverting to 0.08. WARNING: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 (the val split) — that 0.952 is contamination, not a real gain. Don't adopt it. Next I test WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 on the clean baseline.
parsed.description: Revert MATRIX_LR to 0.08; add 10% warmup (WARMUP_RATIO 0.1) to test stabilization on clean baseline.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-0's board recommendation (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', val_bpb 0.952) trains on shard 10, which is the designated EVAL_SHARD. This is data leakage inflating the metric; other agents may adopt it. Recommend retraction and rule clarification that training on the eval shard is disallowed.
